notes.title: Full Controller Support
notes.content: [h3][b]Hey Strikers! Your New Update is Here![/b][/h3][p]You asked, we listened! The latest update for the Hyperspace Striker Demo is live, and it's a big one. Get ready to kick back and play from the couch, because full controller support has arrived![/p][p]Check out what's new:[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎮 Full Controller Support is LIVE![/b][/p][p][/p][p]That's right! Plug in your favorite controller and enjoy full ship control and UI navigation. We're already working on future improvements like rumble and other cool features to make it feel even better.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/d6aff0009a2bbb897f679b4bcd4995e51f83dfde.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Here's the control scheme:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]LT:[/b] Fire Energy Weapons (Hold to charge!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]RT:[/b] Fire Main Weapons[/p][/*][*][p][b]LB:[/b] Drop Mines[/p][/*][*][p][b]RB:[/b] Fire Rockets[/p][/*][*][p][b]Left Stick:[/b] Movement & Menu Navigation[/p][/*][*][p][b]Right Stick:[/b] Scroll through menus (Hangar, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]A Button:[/b] Select / Confirm[/p][/*][*][p][b]B Button:[/b] Dash (in-game) / Back (in-menu, hold to go back a screen)[/p][/*][*][p][b]X Button:[/b] Start Reload Minigame[/p][/*][*][p][b]Start:[/b] Pause[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]🔧 Stuff We Fixed (Bug Squashing!)[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Enemy bullets will no longer blow each other up right out of the barrel.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Retry (Keep Loadout)" button won't lock you out of the menu anymore if you're broke. It will now properly check your credits first.[/p][/*][*][p]The cost for "Retry (Keep Loadout)" will now correctly show how much it increases each time you use it.[/p][/*][*][p]Your loadout now correctly resets when you go back to the Ship Selection screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned out some old scripts related to a "boost" system that no longer exists.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]✨ Making Life Easier (QoL)[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]The game is now smart enough to know if you're using a controller or M+K and will swap the controls for you on the fly.[/p][/*][*][p]In menus, you can now tap B to jump to the 'Back' button or hold it to go to the previous screen instantly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]⚖️ Rebalancing the Arsenal[/b][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]We've re-adjusted damage numbers for all weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Mines are back! We've [b]TRIPLED[/b] their damage to make them a seriously deadly build choice once again. Go blow some stuff up![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for all your feedback, and happy flying![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content: [h3]As promised, we've solved several issues that were found since our last patch. Please give the game a try and let us know if you encounter any new problems.[/h3][p][/p][h1][/h1][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Combo buffs no longer remain active after switching ships.[/p][/*][*][p]Retrying a level now correctly resets your build to the one you had at the start.[/p][/*][*][p]The mining beam no longer consumes power ammo or halt its regeneration.[/p][/*][*][p]Turret drones no longer use regular ammo or spend it on left-click.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage indicators now display as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]It's no longer possible to pause the game during events that have their own pause state, such as leveling up or viewing the demo splash screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3]New Feature[/h3][list][*][p]Upon game over, you now have the option to retry the level with your current build. Doing so will forfeit all credits earned during that run. The credit cost for this option will increase with each subsequent retry.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Full Gameplay Overhaul
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/1c9ac7b45e29ae34a3bba13aefffdc1893af53d7.png"][/img]Patch notes for the Demo version 0.6[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Important[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]This is still a work in progress and does not represent the final state of the full release of the game.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Although an extensive effort was made to remove all detected bugs, some may still occur. We are still working on the best balance in terms of damage and enemy health; there will be builds that might not be viable in all cases or are still too weak or not fun to use.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]We are still working in the best balance in terms of damage and enemy health, there will be builds that might not be viable in all cases or still too weak or not fun to use. [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]No saves will break in this update, but some customized ships might still need some readjusting.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We have worked hard to make sure we could deliver a proper upgrade to the gameplay of our game, making it a more dynamic and enjoyable experience from the start. Please consider this a sneak peek of things to come as we keep working and improving our game. We are open to any and all feedback you can give us.[/p][h3][/h3][h3][b]Detailed Patch Notes[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]New Combat System[/b] With a full rework, we have removed collisions against asteroids and enemies to prevent staggering and slowdowns. Debris now mostly works as a barrier, providing cover from enemy attacks.[/p][p]Other changes include reworking the dash to function as an attack with invulnerability frames. You can now dash head-first through enemy bullets or directly into enemies to deliver the finishing blow.[/p][p][b]New Keybindings[/b] The new key bindings let you take direct control of the action. The current controls are:[/p][list][*][p][b]Hold Left Mouse Button:[/b] Fire main guns[/p][/*][*][p][b]Press Q:[/b] Launch missiles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hold E:[/b] Charge and fire beam weapons[/p][/*][*][p][b]Press F:[/b] Deploy mines[/p][/*][*][p][b]Press R:[/b] Reload[/p][/*][*][p][b]Press Space:[/b] Dash in the direction the ship is facing[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Combo System and Buffs[/b] Our new system keeps track of your kills, rewarding your efforts. Higher kill-combo counts unlock special temporary buffs such as Health Regeneration, Damage Increase, Speed Bonus, Extra Armor, and much more. Be quick, or you will miss the chance to level up and increase those buffs even further![/p][p][b]Level Up Skip Bonus[/b] Previously, if you didn't like any of the chips offered during a level-up, skipping would cause you to lose the experience gained. Now, the bottom-right corner will always offer extra rewards you can consider before taking a new chip, from health increases to extra credits and ammo.[/p][p][b]Reworked Weapons with New Behaviors[/b] The new combat system also brought new functions to all weapons. Offensive weapons now behave more like machine guns of different calibers, with better fire rates, damage, and speed. New, more impactful scatterguns will tear through enemies, and you are now able to fire multiple rockets at once. However, these come at a price. All weapon systems now have associated ammo, which falls into three types.[/p][list][*][p][b]Energy Ammo:[/b] This is used mainly by the dash and energy beam weapons. It depletes as you use it (dashing consumes 50% of its charge), but it regenerates on its own over time when not in use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ordnance Ammo:[/b] This is used by rockets, torpedoes, and mines. The amount spent depends on the payload. Similar to energy ammo, this also regenerates on its own when not in use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regular Ammo:[/b] This is consumed by all main weapons at a rate of one per bullet. It may feel like it never runs out, but as higher-tier cannons fire faster or you use more than one cannon at a time, your ammo will deplete quickly. But fear not, as you can reload to replenish your supply.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Reloading System[/b] Reloading is a small, non-intrusive minigame that lets you regain your regular ammo faster during combat. If timed correctly, it will grant a small bonus with every reload. If you fail, you will only be awarded a third of your maximum ammo.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/87e453f93c7d5e2ffe0b3927ee48af7aa1b0d304.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]the new reloading system, depending on your timing you will get 30%, 100% or 120% of your current maximum ammo. [/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]Note: Although we made other weapon systems fire manually, defensive systems like tail gunners and back-firing cannons (except for rockets) will consume no ammo and fire automatically.[/i][/p][p][b]QoL Improvements[/b] All chips now display their current level in the bottom-right corner, making it easier to track what you have equipped. This is especially useful when leveling up during gameplay.[/p][p]The new and improved controls provide better handling in combat, not only with a better rotation and physics rebalance but also with a well-tested system that, combined with dashing, lets you perform impossible maneuvers to take down the largest and toughest enemies.[/p][p]More tooltips! We were missing a bunch, which left players unsure how things worked. They now show up in sensible areas and even appear as a reminder of the control scheme at the start of every level. This feature will be improved upon in future patches.[/p][p][b]Full Rebalance and Rework of Enemies[/b] With our new combat changes, we made several updates to enemy weapon systems and rebalanced their health and speed. They will now take more damage to compensate for the lack of collision with your ship and your massively increased fire rate. Fear not—although they might feel more challenging at the start, with a couple of level-ups, the tables turn quickly.[/p][p]
[/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/b70965b8183498b29264156571d910bc153f3313.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/441ac31babb07f1a4c0bb9833ba1138e0b1fce21.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/688b3504f37c467bf222d5fba28ae4c6ff89038a.png"][/img][/carousel][h3][b]Other Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Ship parts now align perfectly. The unsatisfying and annoying off-center positioning of wings, bodies, and engines is gone.[/p][/*][*][p]Level selection is now working correctly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Currently Known Bugs:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]These are bugs we have detected after uploading. They will be solved as soon as possible in a hotfix later this week.[/p][list][*][p][b]Mining Beam:[/b] The mining beam is stopping the recharge of power ammo. For some reason, although it does not use power ammo, it stops the recharge completely.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Over/Retry:[/b] Retrying after a "Game Over" does not reset your loadout to your initial one. Instead, it lets you keep your loadout while resetting your level to 0. This will be addressed and integrated more robustly in an upcoming update.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX: v0.02a
notes.content: [h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a minor issue where the game saved your credit amount every time credits were collected. The game now saves after earning 100 credits, at game over, when pausing, upon leveling up, or after completing an enemy wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where the advanced ship class did not include its full starting build. The missing Tier 1 engine upgrade now correctly appears in the build menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the demo timer not pausing with the game. It now tracks time in sync with the rest of the game, preventing the demo splash screen from appearing when the game is paused.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Time!
notes.content: [h3]No progress will be lost.[/h3][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/16b721c49c924b54fd544b77270315abb49edcbf.png"][/img]QoL Improvements[/h2][h3]Hints and Tooltips[/h3][list][*][p]Multiple additions to every menu now include a small tooltip explaining the function of each section. These tooltips will appear on every new game launch and will be addressed in a future update, allowing players to turn them off or reset them.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Level Unlocked[/h3][list][*][p]The level-up menu now explains how to upgrade your ship's systems, making it easier for new players during their first run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Menu Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]It’s now possible to return to the ship selection screen from the pause and game-over menus.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Ship unlocked[/h3][list][*][p]The ship selection screen now displays a notification whenever a new ship is unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New Builds[/h3][list][*][p]New ships come with preloaded tools and weapons suited to their class, making them easier to test immediately.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586196/6258e7d62d9b24c815ac845e08328141e8b9e837.png"][/img][/p][h3]More Upgrades[/h3][list][*][p]All ships now come with two slots to improve armor, engines, or add tools as intended. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][h3]Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Significant performance enhancements have been made. Changes to how multiple textures and animations are loaded have greatly increased game performance, reducing slowdowns when many enemies are on screen.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Better music performance[/h3][list][*][p]Music is now loaded upfront at the start of each run, preventing stuttering caused by loading new tracks mid-run.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Laser weapons no longer break when the game is paused at the wrong moment.[/p][/*][*][p]Tech slots on certain ship classes now appear correctly during gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]The ship selection screen now properly displays newly unlocked ships on the first load.[/p][/*][*][p]Some menus no longer send players to the wrong screen or the title screen unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Music no longer cuts off prematurely under certain conditions, such as game overs.[/p][/*][*][p]Smaller shockwaves no longer cause zero damage to surrounding objects.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]End of transmission...[/p][p][/p]
